title: Create Smooth Curve
content: ### ### ### ### ### Objective Modify Pattern outlines or Internal Lines into smooth curves. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar ▶ Smooth Curve ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar ▶ Smooth Curve 2. Click on a segment or point to establish the first point. → The point appears in grey. ※ Note: (Ver 2026.0) If you click where segments/lines overlap, a menu will pop up. Simply choose whether you want to start on the Pattern Outline or Internal Line. 3. Drag the mouse. → A grey arrow extending from the point follows the cursor. 4. Click on another segment or point to establish the endpoint. → A reference line is created between the two points. 5. With the reference line created, click on the side that will be converted into a smooth curve. → The entire side is highlighted in yellow. 6. Click & drag the reference line to create the desired smooth curve. → The entire outline of the selected side is replaced by the reference line. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438534208793) ### Updated in 2025.0 Curvature of a specific line can be precisely adjusted without affecting other lines. 1. Click a start point and endpoint on the segment or point to set the editing range. 2. Select which side to be edited. 3. Click and drag a segment or point to adjust curvature within the set range. * **Edit** * By default, nearby points adjust proportionally when moving. * You can move only the selected point by holding the [ D ] key while dragging. * Right-click while dragging the segment or point to enter a specific moving distance. * **Add** * Click a segment while holding the [ Ctrl ] key to add a curve point. _* Adding to a Bezier curve points convert it to free curve points, which may adjust the curvature._ * **Delete** * Right-click a point and click the Delete menu to delete selected points. 4. Press Enter to complete. * When selecting a pattern outline or internal line, update based on the edited pattern outline or internal line. * When selecting a reference line, update based on the edited reference line. Segment points will be added at the start and end. * ※ Note: #### Cancel Actions * Cancel All Actions: While using the Smooth Curve tool, press Esc or Ctrl + Z on the keyboard and all actions are undone. * Cancel Last Action: While using the Smooth Curve tool, press Delete or Backspace on the keyboard and the last action is undone.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on using the Smooth Curve tool to transform pattern outlines and internal lines into seamless curves in your design projects.

title: Animation Marker
content: #### **New in 2026.0** **** Animation Markers indicate significant points on the timeline or in space, allowing users to quickly identify the locations of scene transitions, events, and keyframes. Comments can be added to Markers to leave notes regarding editing intentions or task instructions. Additionally, they can be utilized as event triggers in the API via their names. ## **Add** 1. Open the **Animation Editor**. 2. Right-click the **Timeline Ruler** to display the context menu. 3. Click **Add** under the Marker group. 4. When the Marker dialog appears, set the name and frame of the Marker, then click OK. 5. Verify that a new Marker has been created at the specified frame. #### ## **Edit** 1. Hover the mouse over a created Marker to view its name and frame through the displayed tooltip. 2. To move a Marker, select and drag it to the left or right. 3. To edit a Marker's name, double-click the Marker or right-click it and select Edit from the context menu. 4. Modify the information in the displayed dialog, then click OK. 5. Verify that the changes have been applied to the Marker. #### ## **Copy and Paste** 1. Select one or more Markers. 2. Copy the Markers by pressing Ctrl+C or clicking Copy from the right-click context menu. 3. Specify the current frame using the playhead, then paste the Markers by pressing Ctrl+V or clicking Paste from the context menu. 4. The Markers will be pasted at the current frame indicated by the playhead. #### ## **Delete** 1. Select one or more Markers you wish to delete. 2. Press the Delete key or click Delete from the right-click context menu to remove the Markers.
content_description: Discover how to efficiently manage Animation Markers in version 2026.0, enabling streamlined timeline editing and event triggering for enhanced animation workflows.

title: Steam
content: ## Objective Shrink or stretch Fabric partially like as using a steam iron. ## Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam ## Operation #### Steam Setting 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam → All Patterns are now being displayed in mesh. → The Steam Brush appears at the top-left corner of the 2D window. 2. Set the value as desired. Mode (v2026.0) | Add | Operates as a brush that adds Steam. ---|---|--- Remove | Sets Operates as a brush that removes Steam. Option | Shrinkage | Sets the shrinkage level. Size | Sets the size of the brush. Hardness | Sets the hardness of the steam. 3. Click and drag on desired area to steam. → According to the shrinkage, the selected area is now being displayed in light-blue or orange. 4. Activate the Simulate. #### Remove Steam 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam 2. Right-click on a pattern to remove steam, and select either Remove Steam on Selected Pattern or Remove All Steam. → The steam is now being deleted accordingly. ※ Note: It can also be removed from the same right-click pop-up menu with Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern tools.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for using the steam feature to selectively shrink or stretch fabric within a design tool.

title: Avatar: Register Pose/Motion
content: ### Objective Register the motion from FBX file as the motion files compatible with Marvelous Designer Template avatars. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Register Pose/Motion ### ### Operation 1. Click the Main Menu » Avatar » **Register Pose/Motion**. → A popup window with message "All avatars and garments in 3D Window will be deleted. Do you want to proceed?" Click **Proceed** Button if you want to continue. 2. In the Register Pose/Motion window, select the type to register, either **Pose** or **Motion**. 3. Open the FBX file by clicking on the **folder![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438377062425)** button. 4. Select the Gender of the compatible CLO avatar and select the Shoe Type for female. 5. For motion, switch to Animation mode to play loaded motion as needed. 6. Click the **Save** button to save as the Pose(*.pos) or Motion(*.mtn) file. ### Register Pose/Motion window Type | Pose | Register and save as pose (*.pos) file type. ---|---|--- Motion | Register and save as motion (*.mtn) file type. File (FBX) | Select the FBX file with animation to use for registering. Option Gender | Female | Register the pose / Motion to female template avatar. Shoe Type | Select between **Heels** and **flat** shoe types. This setting will affect heel joint rotation of the character. Male | Register the pose / Motion to male template avatar. Kid | Register the pose / Motion to kid template avatar. Region (for motion *.mtn file type only) | Entire | Register the animation from the FBX file to entire region. Play Only | Register the animation from the FBX file to set play region only. Current Frame | Register the animation from the FBX file to current frame. ###
content_description: Easily register and save FBX file motions as compatible pose or motion files for Marvelous Designer template avatars through a user-friendly interface.

title: Seamline Property (ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adjust Seamline properties such as line types, tension, sublayers, topstitch, puckering, and 3D Seamline Normal Maps to render a realistic Garment. ### ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Edit Sewing (B) 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing (B) ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Click on any point or segment of the Sewing Line to display the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Seam | Open | Open a Sewing Style Preset File (*.ssp). Save | The current properties can be saved as a Sewing Style Preset File (.ssp) type file. Information | Name | Set the name of the currently selected sewing line. Sewing Line Type | Turned (Off) | Fold Strength | The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, set the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. Fold Angle | 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚ and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. Turned (On) | Sew two layers of pattern flatly. The Fold Strength and Fold Angle settings cannot be adjusted. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438049347737) Tension | When the 3D garment is expressed as being stretched more than the actual garment, adjust the Tension of Sewing Line. Same as the actual real life concept, Tension is applied based on the short or long side with the Ease and Stretch options. Sewing Line Type | Ease | When the seam lengths differ, this type adds a slight allowance, resulting in a relatively soft sewing tension. Stretch | When the seam lengths differ, this type does not add any allowance, resulting in a more precise and higher sewing tension. Strength | Increase or decrease the strength of the sewing tension by entering the value. The result may vary depending on the Strength even with the same Ratio value. Ratio | Adjust the sewing tension's ratio to express varying drape effects by different sewing methods. Set Sublayer | Assign orders to the Sewing Lines on a Pattern that folds on itself such as seam allowances and pleats, to increase simulation stability. Reverse Direction | Swap the order of the Sewing Line and the Sewed Line. Sublayer | Decide which side of the fabric is attached to the fixed Sewing Line, Back or Front. Topstitch | Name | Rename the Topstitch. Topstitch Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or sticks out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the Pattern. Corner | Curved | Set the Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. Right Angled | Set the Topstitch to be a right angle in the corner of the pattern. Smooth | Set it to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken. Offset | Set the Z Offset of the Topstitch. Placement | Seam A | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Topstitch will be shown on both sides. Puckering | Name | Rename the Puckering. Puckering Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | Extend the start/endpoint of the puckering to the 2D pattern outline. Offset | Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the puckering and the pattern outline. Include the Puckering Width in Offset or not if needed. Z Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the Z-axis and a pattern piece. Placement | Seam A | Puckering will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Puckering will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Puckering will be shown on both sides. 3D Seamline | Plain Seam | Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Directional | Placement | Select Seam A or Seam B for the placement of the seamline. Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions on how to adjust seamline properties in garment design software to achieve realistic sewing effects and textures.

title: Buttonhole Style Window (ver. 2025)
content: ### Objective Add and organize Buttonhole style and apply it to the Buttonholes in the scene. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438074257177) ### ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438070272665) Asset Library icon to open the default location for Buttonhole assets in the New Library Window. #### Add New Buttonhole Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click +Add at the top right. Or add a Buttonhole file by dragging it to the Buttonhole Style tab or on the Buttonhole asset. → A Buttonhole style is added. #### Copy Buttonhole Style & Apply 1. Or after selecting a Buttonhole first, click the Assign Buttonhole to the right of the Buttonhole style. → The Buttonhole Style is replaced. #### Assign New Buttonhole Style 1. A Buttonhole Style can only be deleted if there is no Buttonhole assigned to it. Delete All Unused Buttonholes | Removes unused Buttonholes from the Buttonhole list. Rename | Rename the Buttonhole style. Reset | Resets the properties of the Buttonhole style to the Default Buttonhole properties.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to add, organize, and apply Buttonhole styles in your design scene using the Asset Library in version 2025.0.

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, in addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar USD | *.usd | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. Serves as a universal interchange format for 3D content across various applications and platforms. For more information, please see the [USD file compatibility page.](USD%20file%20Compatibility) USDZ (ver. 2025.0) | *.usdz | X | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. It is a compressed package format that combines all 3D assets into a single file. Primarily used for AR/VR applications and interactive 3D content. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | *.sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive overview of supported file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, detailing their contents and compatibility for enhanced workflow efficiency.

title: Avatar IK Joint Mapping (2025.0)
content: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrfygGSENOY ### Objective Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars. The avatar must have properly defined joint points. Rigging must include key joints such as shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, knees, and ankles. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶ IK Joint tab ### IK Joint Mapping ※ Note: The FBX file must not contain joints with duplicate names, and IK mapping may not apply correctly for creatures or quadruped avatars with non-human structures. Joints are categorized into required and optional, and you must map all required joints to ensure proper IK setup. ![IK.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438084949529) For optional joints, we recommend mapping those indicated in the image if they are present in the avatar to achieve more accurate results. ## ![IK_Optional.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438039415193) **1\. Auto Mapping** If the avatar meets the following conditions, click the Auto Mapping at the top right to apply automatic mapping. • If each joint name of the avatar matches that of the Marvelous Designer avatar. • If the avatar is from one of the following platforms: Daz 3D, Adobe Mixamo, Reallusion Character Creator, or Unreal Engine MetaHuman. **2\. Manual Mapping** 1\. Click the desired item from the image or list in the IK Mapping tab, then click the joint to be mapped on the avatar in the 3D Window. * Alternatively, you can first click the joint on the avatar and then click an item from the tab. 2\. When Symmetry Mapping option at the top right is turned on, the corresponding joint on the opposite side is automatically mapped. Note that both sides must be named as follows: Left_/Right_, L_ / R_,Left / Right,_L / _R,_Left / _Right. 3\. Once all mapping is set up, adjust IK Pose. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438053745049) ### Set Pose Set the avatar in a T-pose to ensure proper compatibility with Marvelous Designer avatar pose and motion files apply correctly. 1\. Adjust the avatar’s joints directly to a T-pose using the gizmo in the 3D window. * If the avatar is already in a T-pose, this step can be skipped. 2\. Click the Set T-Pose at the top right. **※ Note:** • If set correctly, the Reset Pose activates, allowing you to check the set T-pose when clicked. • After adjusting the pose during IK mapping, click the Reset Pose button to revert the avatar to the set T-pose. **Open/Save** You can manage the IK data mapped to the avatar as a file. * Click Open/Save at the top right to open or save IK data as a .iks file. * IK files are only compatible between avatars that have been mapped.
content_description: This web page provides detailed guidance on streamlining IK joint mapping for avatars in order to achieve natural movement and ensure compatibility across various poses and motions.

title: Seam Taping
content: Create Seam Taping Extend Seam Taping Seam Taping Physical Properties ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## ## Create Seam Taping ### Objective Reinforce edges of Patterns to withstand from drooping down by gravity when Simulating. ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Segment Pattern ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Seam Taping ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Pattern Segment ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Seam Taping 2. Select a segment Pattern to reinforce. → The selected segment is now being highlighted in orange color. 3. Activate the Simulate. → The seam tape is now being applied to the selected segment and being reinforced. ※ Note: * Click-and-drag also allows applying seam tapes. * When the Seam Taping tool is active, the applied seam tape is color coded with arrows indicating the direction of applied seam tape (ver. 2024.2). ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438288340249) ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## Extend Seam Tapping (Ver. 2024.2) ### Objective Edit the seam tape extension output with options for overlapped and non-overlapped structures when 2 or more seam taping are intersected can be created. (Example: To create non-overlapped seam taping, first seam taping stop on the outline; second seam taping stop on the 1st seam taping) ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Extend ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Extend 2. Use the drop-down menu to select the stop position options: None, To Outline, and To Seam Taping. * * **Extend (None)** = Does not extend. * **Extend (To Outline)** = Extend to the pattern outline * **Extend (To Seam Taping)** = Extends to the seam taping area of ​​the intersected line. ※ Note: The arrow direction indicate the direction of seam taping. The end without arrow tip is the start of seam taping. And the end with arrow tip is the end of the seam taping. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438288569497) ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## Seam Taping Physical Properties ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Physical Property ### Operation Physical Property | Fabric or Elastic ---|--- Preset | Select default presets from the dropdown menu: * Fusible (common) * Fusible (lapel) * Fusible (nonwoven) * Fusible (nonwoven_Small Parts) * Reinforcement (Bone Pocket) * Reinforcement (Under Collar) * Custom (see Detail) Use the folder icon to open the file explorer. Use the Save icon to save a custom made property. Detail | Depending on Fabric or Elastic options, you can adjust the additional Material simulation properties based on specific material property sliders.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive guidelines for utilizing the Seam Taping tool in garment design software, covering its creation, extension, and physical properties to enhance pattern integrity during simulation.

title: Besides Windows version, Is your software also available for Mac and Linux too?
content: Yes, Marvelous Designer is available for **Windows** and **macOS** for Personal and Enterprise licenses. For **Linux** , the software is available **only for Enterprise customers** upon request. title: Account Integration FAQ User Guide (CLO-SET account)
content: ## **Objective** **Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account.** This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for **Marvelous Designer** **Personal** & **Student** license account types. This change will NOT affect Enterprise & Academic account types at this time. Please check the general [FAQ](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us) if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). ## ## **Details** ### 1) Change in sign-in method **Effective date on** the release of Marvelous Designer 2024.0. **What does this cover?** Marvelous Designer website / Software version 2024.0 and above. | **Software Version** **(12,11,10 and below)** | **Software Version** **Above 2024.0** ---|---|--- **How to login** | **Existing User ID & Password** | **CLO-SET Account & Password ** #### ### 2) How do I get a “CLO-SET Account & Password” if I have an existing Marvelous Designer ID? Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous Marvelous Designer ID? With your old Marvelous Designer ID you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. #### ### 4) I am using a perpetual license for Marvelous Designer. Do I have to merge my account? You do not have to If you are only logging into Marvelous Designer software only. If you want to access the Marvelous Designer website, you will need to follow the on screen prompt to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Or you can check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 5) Can I still use my Perpetual License after I merge my account with CLO-SET?** ** Yes**!** All data/assets/subscription information associated with your pre-existing account will remain the same. You can download your software licenses from the same location, in “[My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)” page. #### ### 6) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account? You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET Account & Password. #### ### 7) I have a subscription license for Marvelous Designer and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different sign in or can I use the CLO-SET account? * If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 12: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your User ID & Password (same as before). * For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. ### 8) I bought items from the Marvelous Designer Store (before CONNECT existed). Where can I download my purchased items? All items purchased from the Marvelous Designer Store will be downloadable from [CONNECT's My Page > Purchase](https://connect.clo-set.com/mypage/purchase) tab. *This applies to purchases made after April 28, 2020 on the Marvelous Designer store page. If you have purchases made before April 28, 2020, those are still stored and downloadable from the Marvelous Designer > [My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) page. ### 9) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer IDs and I use them frequently. How does it affect me? You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is sign in with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. ### 10) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts? Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact our support team at [support@clo-set.com](mailto:support@clo-set.com) or **[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new)**. ### 11) I am using my software in an offline environment. Does this change affect me? Your access to your software will remain unaffected, you can continue using your pre-existing account user ID & password without change. If you choose to sign in to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041-Account-Merging-from-CLO-SET)**. ### 12) How do I change my password after I merge my accounts into a CLO-SET account? When you click 'Change Password' on the Marvelous Designer website or any CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) product page, you will be redirected to the CLO-SET ‘[My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)’, where you can change your password. If you are already on the CLO-SET website, you can change the password under the settings tab on “[My page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)”. * If you are using a version of the software below 2024.0, your password for the software will not be synchronized with CLO-SET account. **See Question 13 if you want to change your password for an older version. ### 13) I'm using a version of Marvelous Designer that is below 2024.0 (Version 12,11,10, 9, etc). How do I change my password for my software login? * If you have integrated into the CLO-SET account: contact us via [the Marvelous Designer support team](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new). * If you don’t have an integrated CLO-SET account: reset your password via the [password reset page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/member/identify). ### 14) What happens to my subscription cycle if I change my account email? Changing your account email will NOT impact your subscription cycle or payment information. Please note that the email notifications on the renewal and payment confirmation will be sent to your original email registered at the point of subscription. ### 15) I have paid CLO-SET or CLO accounts, does this mean I get Marvelous Designer for free? No, the integration is only for login methods not purchasing and licensing. The paid CLO-SET and CLO services will remain separate from each other and require their own purchases for use. **If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please contact us at******[**support@clo-set.com**](mailto:support@clo-set.com) **or[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new), and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.**
content_description: This webpage provides essential information on the updated login methods for Marvelous Designer users, allowing access to all CLO Virtual Fashion services through a single CLO-SET account.

title: User Pool Manual
content: ## **Description:** Userpool is the feature included in the License Account Admin page along with the launch of Marvelous Designer 2024.2 for those that are integrated with CLO-SET. Please read the page in the link below for more information on account integration. [(LINK to the page](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce)) Userpool enhances the experience of license management with multiple & single users and provides higher security around the license usage as well. The Userpool can be found and accessed at the left side of the menu bar inside of the [license account admin page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole). ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438167645209) ***IMPORTANT** In order to access the User Pool, you will need to have your Company ID integrated with CLO-SET as part of our optional One-Step login process. You will need to integrate your Company ID, and End User IDs (License IDs) under your company as well, with a valid working email address in order to operate the Userpool feature fully. Any users who are invited to accounts must be integrated with CLO-SET as well. ## **Offerings:** ### **[Userpool Settings]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438139894937)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202253977)** * Userpool is set to be enabled as its default upon completing account integration. * From ‘Userpool Settings’, you can also choose to turn it off for a specific License ID if you wish not to share it. * Push the slide bar in order to disable userpool from certain License ID. * If the userpool gets turned off while the selected License ID is assigned with 1 or multiple members, they will be removed afterward. ### **[Add Members]** **:** How to add the members to Userpool? * By License Account admin (Website) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438202459161)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168278297)** * After clicking ‘Add Member’ button, the pop up window will appear * Choose certain License ID that you want to have assigned with members who are in needs of license usage * Type in a member's ID (email address) to assign. This also can be done with multiple number of member IDs at once. * Once the add member procedure is completed followed by the steps above, the member information will appear on the page, and the email will be sent for the verification on the member’s end. * By Software (Marvelous Designer) _*'Auto Add' option has to be on for this function_ **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438155478425)** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168763033)** * The end user logs-in to Marvelous Designer with License ID * Use ‘Sign in with CLO-SET account’ or ‘Switch CLO-SET Account’ feature * CLO-SET accounts that are logged-in via software followed by above step, will be automatically added into Userpool ### **[Auto Add]** **:** What is Auto Add? * After the log-in to Marvelous Designer by License ID and signing in with a CLO-SET account inside of the Software (Sign in with CLO-SET, Switch CLO-SET Account), the CLO-SET Email is automatically added to the user pool of the corresponding License ID. _(Process)_ * Log in to Marvelous Designer with License ID ‘A’, and sign in with a CLO-SET account ‘B’ * This CLO-SET account ‘B’ will be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * If you switch the account to different CLO-SET account while using the software, then it will also be added to user pool, underneath the License ID ‘A’ * This option can be turned off at the License Account Admin - Userpool page. * ‘Auto Add’ option is only available for Onlineauth type of license. * ‘Auto Add’ will only work with License ID that has the email address attached. * If you try to assign members via ‘Auto Add’ option to the License ID that does not have an eligible email address attached, it will not function properly. ### **[Send Installer/ Delete]** ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438168906009) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156039705) * If you need to send out the installer for a certain version, or to make sure the end user received it well on their side, use the ‘Send Installer’ button. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203487001) * Also, the delete of member ID is available by clicking on the ‘Delete’ button * If a member is using more than one License ID, then you can choose License IDs you want to delete the member from. ### **[Name Edit]** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438219288217)** * You can assign nicknames to members for efficient management. This helps distinguish between members and take accurate actions. Use member names to simplify team management. ***ACCOUNT STATUS** * Not Integrated / Company blocked CLO-SET account Integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438203817497)** * Not Integrated/ Company allowed CLO-SET account integration **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438156861081)** * Integrated with CLO-SET **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438204151961)** * Integrated (End User with Standalone License and have Sub Account(Member)) **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438190725657)** ### **Offering by License Type:** * The Userpool feature allows you to manage access to your software license. Its functionality varies depending on your license type. ### [Network Online Licenses (Academic, Enterprise) and Linux License] * Adding Members: With these licenses, you can add an unlimited number of members to your Userpool using the "Add Member" feature. * Concurrent Users: While you can add as many members as you need, the number of users who can log in and use the software at the same time is limited by the number of licenses you own. ***Note:** If the number of concurrent users exceeds your license limit, users will not be able to log in. * Platform Restriction for Linux License: A member added for a Linux license can only use the software on the Linux OS. They will be unable to log in on Mac or Windows operating systems. *Note: If a Linux license member attempts to log in on an incompatible OS, an error will occur. ### [Enterprise Standalone, Personal, and Student Licenses] * Adding a Member: These licenses are limited to a single concurrent user, so you can only add one additional member using the "Add Member" feature. *Important: If you add a new Member, it will automatically replace and delete the previous one. * Concurrent Users: The concurrent user count for these licenses is one. This means that only one user, either the main account or the added Member, can be logged in at a time. * Note: The Standalone License will be retired as of December 2, 2025. For more information on this change, please refer to the[ ](https://www.google.com/search?q=link)Marvelous Designer Standalone License Transition. * Userpool feature summary by license type **License Type** | **Number of Members** | **Concurrent User** | **Supported Operating System** ---|---|---|--- Network Online (Enterprise, Academic) | Unlimited | Equal to the number of the licenses that you own | Win, Mac Linux | Unlimited | Equal to the number of the licenses that you own | Linux only Enterprise Standalone | One | One | Win, Mac Personal | One | One | Win, Mac Student | One | One | Win, Mac
content_description: Discover how Userpool enhances license management and security for Marvelous Designer users integrated with CLO-SET, enabling efficient user access and streamlined administrative functions.

title: What are Company ID and License ID?
content: A **Company ID** is essential for purchasing licenses and managing your **License IDs**. It enables you to buy and allocate licenses to users, while also providing an overview of the status of all **License IDs** under your account. Please note that a **License ID** is for login purposes only and cannot be used to make purchases. To transfer or rearrange a **License ID** to another Company ID, please [contact our support team](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/ko/support/contact).
content_description: This web page provides essential information about the Company ID, its role in managing License IDs, and guidance for license allocation and support.

title: I purchased a license, but it's not showing up.
content: If you have completed your purchase but the license is not visible in your account, it is likely due to a temporary processing delay, particularly with certain payment methods. In rare cases, license issuance may be delayed when paying via **PayPal**. This is typically caused by a communication lag between servers (PayPal and our system). * **Average Wait Time:** Most licenses are issued within a few minutes to an hour. * If your license has not been issued after **more than 2 hours** , please contact our Support Team for assistance.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on what to do if your license is not visible in your account after purchase, including potential delays and contact information for support.

title: Disconnect License ID from CLO-SET Integration
content: #### **Introduction** The Disconnect CLO-SET feature allows an authorized user to disconnect a CLO-SET integration from an account or a specific License ID. After disconnection, the account or License ID will no longer be integrated with CLO-SET. #### **Who can disconnect CLO-SET integration?** Only Company IDs can disconnect their own CLO-SET integration and the CLO-SET integrations linked to License IDs under their company. #### **Where to disconnect CLO-SET integration?** 1. Disconnect Company ID's CLO-SET Integration My Page -> Account Tab -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button 2. Disconnect License ID's CLO-SET Integration License Account Admin-> License Tab -> Click a License ID to view its details -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button #### **Requirements** All Enterprise Type(Company ID & License ID) accounts integrated with CLO-SET are eligible for disconnection. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a Company ID?** 1. **You can no longer log in to Marvelous Designer using the connected CLO-SET account.** Once disconnected, that CLO-SET account can no longer be used to access Marvelous Designer. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The email address remains unchanged and a****utomatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. So please please change the CLO-SET account email is different from this Company ID’s email. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a License ID?** 1. **The connected CLO-SET user can no longer use this License ID in Marvelous Designer.** Once disconnected, the CLO-SET account previously linked to this License ID loses access to the license. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The License ID remains active and manageable.** Disconnecting CLO-SET does not delete the License ID. The License ID can be reassigned or connected to a different CLO-SET account. 4. **Automatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. To prevent automatic reconnection, use a different email address or leave the email field empty. ### **Steps** #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **Company ID** 1. Go to My Page and open the Account tab. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365600281) 2. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365602329) 3. Click to proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381651865) * * * #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **License ID** 1. Go to the License ID details page and select a License ID and view its detail page. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381653017) 2. In the Email section, click Disconnect CLO-SET. (This button is available only if the License ID is integrated with a CLO-SET account.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365610393) 3. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. 4. Click to Proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365614617)
content_description: The Disconnect CLO-SET page provides authorized users with step-by-step instructions to safely disconnect their CLO-SET integration from Company IDs or License IDs, while outlining the implications of disconnection.

title: License ID Deletion
content: #### **Introduction** The Delete License ID feature allows authorized administrators to permanently remove a License ID from the system. This action is only available under specific conditions and requires careful review before proceeding. #### **Who can delete a License ID?** * Company ID Holder (Enterprise Administrator) #### **Where to delete a License ID?** 1. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> Delete License ID Button 2. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> License ID Detail Page -> Delete License ID Button #### **Requirements** A target License ID needs to meet the requirements below: 1. **CLO-SET integration must be disconnected first.** If the License ID is currently integrated with a CLO-SET account, the integration must be disconnected before the License ID can be deleted. 2. **Active licenses cannot be deleted.** A License ID that holds an active license cannot be deleted. To proceed, you must first end the license subscription. If this is not possible, please contact us or reach out to your account manager for further assistance. #### **What happens if you delete a License ID** Deleting a License ID permanently affects access and data associated with the license. Please review the following before proceeding. 1. **Access will be revoked** Once the License ID is deleted, users assigned to this license will no longer be able to launch Marvelous Designer or use any of its features. 2. **Activity tracking will stop** After deletion, no further activity or usage data associated with this License ID will be recorded. 3. **This action cannot be undone** A deleted License ID cannot be restored. Even if you create a new License ID with the same name, it will not be connected to any previous data. Please make sure to review everything carefully before deleting a License ID. #### **Steps** 1. Go to the License tab in License Account Admin. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428436213657) 2. Click Delete License ID ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467931033) 3. Review the policy and proceed to the next modal. ![스크린샷 2025-12-22 오후 2.44.25.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53571698977049) 4. Select the License ID you want to delete Only License IDs that meet the deletion policy will show up and be selectable.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467934105) 5. Clear up all filters and check if the selected License ID(s) is deleted from the License ID list.
content_description: This web page provides detailed guidance for authorized administrators on how to safely and permanently delete a License ID from the system while outlining the necessary requirements and implications of the action.

title: Network Offline License Setup Guide
content: *** If the purchase is for perpetual version update with USB Dongle type of license, please click **[**here**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358413513369)**for its manual.** ** If the purchase is for Network Offline Subscription type, please refer below. Marvelous Designer Network Offline Licenses will be provided with a software license key (SL Key). Here are a few reminders when it comes to the SL key setup process. **[Checklists]** **Category** | **Server Environment** ---|--- **Content** | * Will not work on the same server as a USB dongle license type. * Due to technical reasons, software license keys cannot be set up on the same server where a physical USB dongle (HW key) is installed. In this case, we recommend using a separate server. However, if you happen to use the same server for both license types, please let the sales team know. **Category** | **Virtual Server** ---|--- **Content** | * Available to set up on a virtual server, but a fee for reissuing the SL key may arise due to a server down. * SL key is able to be set up on a virtual server, but if the SL key is damaged due to a server down, for example, you may have to request a reissued key from our sales team (a Reissuing Fee will be charged). In this case, please contact the sales team. **Category** | **Transfer SL Key to a different server (For Windows server only)** ---|--- **Content** | * [**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358269749785)******Rehost SL Key Manual** * This functionality is available only if the original server, where the SL key is currently installed, is valid and the new server is set up and ready. Based on your current license status or server OS type, there will be a specific manual for each case. Please check the table below and follow steps that is applicable to you. **[Process in a C2V file Generating]** **1) First time installing network offline license** **Step** | **Explain** | **Manual Link** ---|---|--- **1** | Create a new C2V file on the main server. | **1.**[**Link to**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/51987415945241-Requesting-Network-Software-License-activation-First-Time-installation)******Windows OS** **2.**[**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358314041881)******Linux OS****** **3.**[**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358326503577)******Mac OS** **2** | Send C2V file at sales@marvelousdesigner.com or to a representative that is in contact with | **-** **3** | Apply the V2C file you receive | [**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358418345625)******Manual** **2) Existing SL key updates due to subscription renewal or additional copies** **Step** | **Explain** | **Manual Link** ---|---|--- **1** | Create a C2V file for the key update. | [**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358290236953)******Manual****** **2** | Send C2V file at sales@marvelousdesigner.com or to a representative that is in contact with | - **3** | Apply the V2C file you receive | [**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358418345625)******Manual** **3) Separate license activation (Second or above installation) on the same server** **Step** | **Explain** | **Manual Link** ---|---|--- **1** | Create a new C2V file followed by the manual, and send C2V file at sales@marvelousdesigner.com or to a representative that is in contact with | [**Link**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358346786585)**to********Manual** **2** | Apply the V2C file you receive | [**Link to**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358418345625)******Manual** If you have any questions regarding the contents above, please contact at [sales@marvelousdesigner.com](mailto:sales@marvelousdesigner.com)
content_description: This web page provides essential guidelines and resources for setting up and managing Marvelous Designer licenses, including USB Dongle and Network Offline Subscription types.

title: Puckering Style Window (2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adds Puckering Styles and controls their properties. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Puckering Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Puckering Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438120178585) ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/54024056899481) Asset Library icon to open the default location for Puckering assets in the New Library Window. #### Add New Puckering Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click "+Add" in the Object Browser. Or add a Puckering file (.PTP) by dragging it to the Puckering tab or on the Puckering asset. → A Puckering style is added. #### Copy Puckering Style & Apply 1. Click Copy at the top right. → A Puckering style is duplicated. 2. Replace an existing Puckering Style and apply it. Or after selecting the Puckering first, click the Assign button to the right of the Puckering style. → The Puckering Style is replaced. #### Assign New Puckering Style 1. Select 1 or more existing Puckering assets in either the 2D window with the Edit Puckering Tool. 2. Right-click with the Puckering object selected to open the context menu. 3. When **Assign New Puckering** is executed, a new Puckering style (*.PTP) is created and automatically assigned to all selected Puckering objects.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for adding, copying, and assigning Puckering Styles in the Object Browser, enhancing the customization of garment properties in the latest version of the software.

title: Trim Style Window (2025.0)
content: ### Objective Manage Trims as a shape or style in the Trim Window. It is possible to create, copy, apply, and set a style in the Trim list window. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Trim (Ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Object Browser ▶ Trim (Ver. 2025.0) ![ObjectBrowser-Trim.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438055259929) ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the Asset Library icon ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438055387417) to open the default location for Trim assets in the New Library Window. #### Add & Apply one or more Trim Styles 1\. Click Add at the top right to load a file( .trm, .obj, .fbx or .zip)to use as Trim. or Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ/FBX/USD and import a file, In the popup window, choose Object Type as Trim. or drag and drop a file (from Library or File Explorer) directly to the Trim Style Window or 3D window. **→** A Trim style is added. 2\. Drag the style from the Trim window to the 3D window, apply it, and Glue. #### Copy Trim Style & Apply 1. Click Copy at the top right in the Trim Style window. → A Trim style is duplicated. 2. Drag onto an existing Trim Style and apply it. Or after selecting the Trim Style first, click the Assign button to the right of the Trim style. → The Trim Style is replaced. #### Change Trim Styles 1\. Use the Select/Move tool to select a trim in the 3D window. 2\. Click the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438070828441) Assign button to the right of the trim style name. Or drag and drop a Trim style onto the trim you've selected. **→** The selected Trim's style has been changed. 3\. Right-click on Trim to Delete / Delete all Unused Trims / Rename (Ver. 2025.0). ※ Note: The default file format for Trim in Marvelous Designer is .TRM file. Other supported file formats for importing Object Types as trim include .OBJ, .FBX, and .USD.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing and applying Trim styles in the Trim Window of Marvelous Designer, offering detailed instructions on creating, copying, and modifying trims.

title: Library Window
content: Starting from **Marvelous Designer 2025.2** , the Library(Legacy) window has been integrated into the **New Library** window and is no longer available. 📒[**New Library Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358127622809-New-Library-Window-2025-0) * * * ### Objective Conveniently manage and open files in the program using the Library Window. Add frequently used folders to the Library to easily open files: drag and drop a file from the registered folder into the 3D Window or with the left mouse button, double click the file. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Library Side Panel Title Bar ▶ Right-click Drop Down Menu ▶ Library (Ver. 2025.0) ### Operation #### Icon Menus (Top/Bottom) - Library Window Download (Ver. MD10) | Download the newly added default files as a whole. Selectively download files from the folder with the "N" sign. ---|--- Reset | Reset registered folders in the Library. Add Folder | Add frequently used folders to the Library. Refresh | Apply any changes made in the Library such as deleting or adding folders. Select All (Downloadable Items Only) | If you activate a checkbox on the top left corner of downloadable items, the 'Select All' button will appear where the Refresh button used to be. A single selection will select the entire downloadable items, and clicking the button again will deselect all. List / Icon | Toggle between different views. (ver2.3.0) Search | Use Search to locate files quickly and efficiently within the Library.(ver3.0.0) #### Right Mouse Button Menus - Library Window Click the RMB on the folders at the top or bottom of the Library window to access the menus below. Delete | Delete the bookmarked folder. ---|--- Rename | Renaming the bookmark folder. The name of the original folder saved on the computer will not be changed. Show in Explorer (Ver. 12.1) | Open the explorer window where the bookmarked folder or the selected folder and files are located. Add to Workspace | Add the corresponding item to the workspace ※ Note: Hover over the desired Project/Garment file thumbnail to preview font, back, and side views.
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for users to efficiently navigate and utilize the new Library window in Marvelous Designer 2025.2 for managing and accessing files.

title: Offset as Internal Line
content: ### Objective Input specific measurements to offset Patterns and segments as Internal Lines. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern ### Operation #### Offset as Internal Line 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Right-click on top of a Pattern and select Offset As Internal Line from the pop-up menu. → The Offset as Internal Line window appears. 3. Configure the settings as needed. Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be generated ---|--- Distance | Set the interval between each Internal Line. All | Set the distance of all segments to be the same. Individual (Ver. 2025.0) | Set the spacing for each line segment individually. Offset From (Ver. 2025.0) | When inputting individual distances, the individual line can be set as the previous or selected line. Reverse Direction | Change in the reverse direction of the selected segment. Both Sides (Ver. 2025.0) | Create internal lines in both directions based on the selected segment. Extend | to Pattern Outline | Extend to Pattern Outline. to Internal Line | Extend to Internal Line of the pattern. 4. Click OK. → Depending on the settings, the internal line/shape is created. → If it is a curve, the curve point is automatically optimized. #### Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Select the two Pattern outlines between where the Internal Lines are created. 3. Right click on the selected Pattern outline and select Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) → The Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 4. Adjust the options below as needed, then select OK. Name | Description ---|--- Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be created. Offset | Set the distance between each Internal Lines. Distance to Segment Edge | Set the distance from the Pattern outlines for the Internal Lines. Reverse Direction | Horizontally reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Opposite Segment | Vertically reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Straight Line | Create Internal Lines as straight lines. Perpendicular Direction | Create Internal Lines perpendicular to the selected Pattern outlines. → Internal Lines are created based on the above settings. ※ Note: * Using the same function, additional Internal Lines can be created between Internal Lines. * When the Pattern outlines or Internal Lines are divided in multiple segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to select them all.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to offset patterns and segments as internal lines within a 2D design environment.

title: Edit Graphic Size (Property Editor)
content: ### Objective Use the Property Editor to resize, recolor adjust location and texture for all graphics. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Texture (2D) /Transform Graphic ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline in Location 2. Select the graphic to be edited. → The selected graphic's properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Find the Graphic Transformation category. Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Enter a name for the graphic. Classification | Select one of the following graphic types: Embroidery, Logo, Print, or Wash (Jeanologia). Material | Configure the graphic's material, texture, color, and transparency. Graphic Configuration | Face | Place the graphic on the front, back, or both sides. Over Seamline (Ver. 10) | Place the graphic on the seam of patterns. ※Note: \- Graphic does not appear when the difference of the seam is over the allowable extent. \- Graphic may not be matching when it is placed over the curves. It this case, deactivate this option and adjust the graphic manually. Tile | Tile the graphic along the X or Y axis of a Pattern while maintaining its original size. ※ Note: The same option is available in the right-click pop-up menu. Graphic Transformation | Adjust the rotation angle, width, height, and Z-Offset(Ver. 10) of the graphic.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on using the Property Editor to effectively resize, recolor, and adjust the location and texture of graphics in your design projects.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Slider and Stopper Properties
content: ### Objective Set and modify the Zipper Slider, puller and Stopper properties. ※ Note: The Puller, Slider, and Stopper of the zipper have been separated so that each can be individually selected and edited. (Ver. 2025.0). ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation * Select the tool indicated in Location. * Select a Zipper or Stopper created on a 3D Garment and modify its properties: Option | Description ---|--- Name | Customize the name of the zipper. Type (Ver. 2025.0) | One Way | One slider and puller is shown. Two Way | Two sliders and pullers are shown which can be moved in opposite directions. Direction (Ver. 2025.0) | Direction can be configured when the type is set to Two Way. Bottom to Bottom | Slider and Puller will be positioned near the Stopper, at the end of the zipper. Head to Head | Slider and Puller will be positioned of the original position. Shape | Slider | Select a shape for the slider. Puller | Select a shape for the puller. Stopper | Select the Stopper type (Open / Closed End) and then select shapes for Top and Bottom. (ver MD10) ※ Note: A selection of Bottom shapes is configured based on the shape of the Stopper. Specification | Gauge | Select the size of the Slider by Gauge or percentage. Weight (g) | Assign the weight of the slider. (Ver 4.2) Fasten Zipper | Reverse Zip Direction | Select the zip direction. The slider is relocated based on the option. Move to Opposite Side | Select a side of the zipper tape where the slider will locate when the zipper is open. Material | Configure the Slider's Type, Texture, Color, and Opacity. ※ Note: Uncheck Use Same Material as Slider after selecting the Puller or Stopper tab to assign material separately. (Ver. 10) Polygon Optimization (Ver. 2024.0) | Count | Set the number of polygons. Plane | This is applied in the form of a texture when the Plane is activated. Count cannot be set on Plane activation. ※ Note: * Adjust the weight of the Slider
content_description: This web page provides users with the tools to customize and modify the properties of Zipper Sliders, Pullers, and Stoppers in a 3D garment design environment.
